title: Het Schipke

buildingCutout.basis: Native OpenStreetMap outline of the individually listed Het Schipke corner house.

terrainReference.basis: Original Flemish DHMVII 1-metre ground sample at the public corner pavement.

mapIdentity.scope: Exact public-domain exterior already published on Qualla, cited historic protection record, native OSM footprint and Flemish 1-metre ground and roof surveys.

note: The Flemish heritage inventory identifies a two-storey, five-bay corner house and clipped mansard. The exact Qualla view shows the blue stone corner portal, white facade, sash arrangement, dormer and terra-cotta roofs.
